diff_policy.tolerance_rationale: Widened harness-wide from an initial arbitrary 3.0 after the repeatability check on Port Sheldon showed a 3-run range (4.5 pts) exceeding that tolerance. This deal's own range (2.0 pts at n=9) would have been fine at 3.0, but a single harness-wide tolerance keeps the pilot simple; per-deal tolerance calibration is a documented follow-up. 2026-11-05 Opus rebaseline: the golden is now an n=6 mean (stdev 0.89, SEM 0.37); a later 3-replay mean's dispersion against it is about sqrt(0.89^2/3 + 0.89^2/6) = 0.63 pts, so a +/-2 sigma band is about 1.26 pts inside the unchanged 5.0-pt tolerance -- fold further Opus samples into the golden at later runs rather than widening the tolerance.
diff_policy.reason: HIGH confidence: fully resolved (zero null categories) across all 9 replays, internally consistent (category sums match Combined in every run), and the tightest or near-tightest repeatability in the set (stdev 0.82, range 2.0 at n=9) -- one of the most reliable rows in the golden set for detecting a real doctrine-edit delta. 2026-11-05 Opus golden: n=6, stdev 0.89, range 2.
